subject: namespace and function resolution in generated Stan programs

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: namespace and function resolution in generated Stan programs
parts:
I was talking to Daniel and Peter on Thursday about scopes
and just realized when I was making a fix over the weekend
that we generate

using stan::math::lgamma;

and

using stan::math;

for each Stan program.

I had taken out the first one, thinking it would be redundant
with the using stan::math, but it's not. Without the explicit
using statement for lgamma, the result is a namespace ambiguity
between ::lgamma and stan::math::lgamma; with the using statement,
it resolves to stan::math.

So this is how we'd override the use of the standard (std::) or top-level
(::) namespaces to use our own definitions.

- Bob
